completenessNote: 来源为 AGC 官方 PDF《S-66-1955-CHINESE-MARRIAGE-FEES-REGULATIONS-1955.pdf》（1 页），本次切分 2 条。该 PDF 为扫描件 + OCR 文本层，正文按版式位置重建：已剔除页眉页脚与边栏条标题、回接折行；未改写措辞、未增删内容。OCR 层面可能存在个别粘连或形近字，逐字引用请以原始 PDF 为准。

text.en: These regulations be cited as the Chinese Marriages Citation. may (Fees) Regulations, 1955, and shall come into operation on the 1st day of November, 1955.

The fee for the registration of Chinese Marriage shall be Fee for a registration two dollars. of Chinese Marriage. Made this 20t11 day of October, 1955. J. O. GILBERT, British Resident, Brunei. British Resident's Office, Brunei, 20th October, 1955. " • ------------------.---------------------------------.--------- Printed at the GOVERNMENT PRINTING OFFICE, KUCHING,

SARAWAK, F. W. LANE, GOVERNMENT PRINTER.
